def put(p,r,ch,midi=None,inst=0,vol=None,fx=0,fp=0):
    assert 0<=p<NPAT and 0<=r<ROWS and 0<=ch<NCH,(p,r,ch)
    if midi is not None: assert 11<=midi<=106,midi
    n=nn(midi)
    v=0 if vol is None else 0x10+int(max(0,min(64,vol)))
    cell=(n,int(inst),v,int(fx),int(fp))
    if (r,ch) in patterns[p] and patterns[p][r,ch]!=cell:
        print('CLASH',p,r,ch,'old',patterns[p][r,ch],'new',cell)
    patterns[p][r,ch]=cell

def off(p,r,ch):
    if 0<=r<ROWS and (r,ch) not in patterns[p]: put(p,r,ch,inst=0) # override below

def stop(p,r,ch):
    if r<ROWS and (r,ch) not in patterns[p]:patterns[p][r,ch]=(97,0,0,0,0)

def lead_bar(p,bar,mel,instrument=9,variant=0,vol=30,echo=True, harmony=False):
  starts=set(row for row,n,dur in mel)
  for i,(x,n,dur) in enumerate(mel):
    if variant==1:
      # end-of-four-bar ornament, identical rhythmic hook but changed final answer
      if bar==3 and x in (8,10,12,14):n+={8:0,10:2,12:4,14:4}[x]
      if bar==2 and x==0:n-=2
    if variant==2:
      # last reprise develops the theme a little, avoiding mechanical repetition
      if bar in (0,2) and x==8:n+=12 if n<=73 else 0
      if bar==3 and x in (12,14):n+=5
    v=vol+(2 if x in (0,8) else 0)-(2 if dur==1 else 0)
    put(p,bar*16+x,12,n,instrument,v,fx=(0x04 if dur>=4 and instrument==9 and x in (0,8) and p in (6,8,14,15,16) else 0),fp=(0x21 if dur>=4 and instrument==9 and x in (0,8) and p in (6,8,14,15,16) else 0))
    # XM key-off one row before next note where room permits; 6-tick release
    if instrument in (9,10) and dur>=3 and x+dur-1<16 and x+dur-1 not in starts:stop(p,bar*16+x+dur-1,12)
    if echo and dur>=2 and x in (0,4,8,12):
      e=x+3
      if e<16:
        ev=12 if instrument==9 else 10
        put(p,bar*16+e,13,n,10,ev)
        if e+2<16:stop(p,bar*16+e+2,13)
    if harmony and x in (0,8) and dur>=3:
      # diatonic third below, use four/semitones as required per upper note
      low=n-3 if n in (78,74,81,76,71) else n-4
      put(p,bar*16+x,19,low,10,15)
      if x+dur-1<16: stop(p,bar*16+x+dur-1,19)
